title: OpenAI built a model to break software

hooks.text: OpenAI just built a model whose job is to break software. On purpose.
948 working Linux kernel exploits. Written by one model.
OpenAI rated its own new model Critical for cyber risk. Here is why.

verified_claims: GPT-6 Cyber finds and validates exploitable vulnerabilities and helps develop fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope
Honeypot out-of-scope avoidance: 99.93% without deployment prompt (94.49% previous), 100% with it
81 novel high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities; 948 working Linux kernel exploits vs 166 for GPT-5.6 Sol (1,724 reproduced)
Classified Critical in cybersecurity under the Preparedness Framework; access via Daybreak Red (authorized testing) and Daybreak Blue (verified defenders)
notes: Numbers quoted exactly as on the OpenAI page dated 2026-11-05. Page read via the in-app browser (automated fetchers get 403).
